description: One integration test drives lead 008 from the posted queue to `quote_sent` against the leadgen and mailbox containers, with the reply read from a recording. Expect: all pass.
After that run the mailbox holds exactly one request and one quote packet for lead 008. Expect: `1 1`.
command: curl -s http://localhost:8025/leads/LEAD-00000042-008/emails | jq -r '[(map(select(.metadata.kind == "routine_request" or .metadata.kind == "sensitive_request")) | length), (map(select(.metadata.kind == "quote_packet")) | length)] | join(" ")'

description: The running app serves the queue and lead 008's detail from live data. Expect: `true`, then `true`.
command: curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/leads | jq -e 'map(.lead_id) | index("LEAD-00000042-008") != null' && curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/leads/LEAD-00000042-008 | jq -e '.lead_id == "LEAD-00000042-008" and (.facts | length) > 0'

description: After a run every lead is at a sent quote packet, one sent request, or an underwriter wait with a stated reason, and lead 000 is a proposed decline waiting for approval while 003 and 006 each show one underwriter card. Expect: all pass.
No lead has two open requests: the mailbox holds at most one request per lead and round. Expect: `0`.
command: curl -s 'http://localhost:8025/emails?limit=1000' | jq '[.[] | select(.metadata.kind == "routine_request" or .metadata.kind == "sensitive_request")] | group_by(.lead_id, .metadata.round) | map(select(length > 1)) | length'

description: Stand's answer key agrees on every seed-42 record it decides. Expect: all pass.
The reference eval run passes every grader and appends one `run` row. Expect: exit 0, then `true`.
command: make eval ARGS='--suite seed42' && tail -n 1 evals/results.jsonl | jq -e '.kind == "run" and .suite == "seed42" and (.scores | to_entries | all(.value.passed)) and (.critical_errors | length == 0)'

description: Each control is caught by its named grader: do nothing by Coverage, email everything by Forbidden asks and Asks, send twice by Send safety. Expect: three lines naming the failed graders, each containing the named grader.
command: for c in do_nothing email_everything send_twice; do make eval ARGS="--suite seed42 --control $c" >/dev/null; tail -n 1 evals/results.jsonl | jq -r '[.control, ([.scores | to_entries[] | select(.value.passed | not) | .key] | join(","))] | join(": ")'; done

description: The results log shows one improvement cycle on reply reading: a run with a failing reply case and a hypothesis, a rerun that passes, and a decision row that keeps it. Expect: `true`.
command: jq -s -e '[.[] | select(.kind == "run" and .suite == "replies")] as $r | ($r | map(select(.hypothesis != null and (.scores | to_entries | any(.value.passed | not)))) | length >= 1) and ($r | map(select(.hypothesis != null and (.scores | to_entries | all(.value.passed)))) | length >= 1) and ([.[] | select(.kind == "decision" and .keep == true)] | length >= 1)' evals/results.jsonl

description: Every underwriter action works against the running app through the same routes the browser calls: approve, edit and reject a draft, approve and reject a pending observation, record an underwriter choice with a reason, resolve a fact, decline a lead, paste a reply. Expect: all pass.
The web page's controls post the right commands and render every item kind, from the browser build. Expect: all pass.
The chat cases pass in the eval: a question causes zero commands and cites event ids; a directive becomes a proposal card and a reworded refused directive stays refused. Expect: exit 0, then `true`.
command: make eval ARGS='--suite chat' && tail -n 1 evals/results.jsonl | jq -e '.kind == "run" and .suite == "chat" and (.scores | to_entries | all(.value.passed))'

description: The reply suite passes with Jev answering the classification first (replayed Jev recordings) and with no Jev key. Expect: exit 0 twice, then `true` twice.
command: make eval ARGS='--suite replies --jev' && tail -n 1 evals/results.jsonl | jq -e '.suite == "replies" and .jev == true and (.scores | to_entries | all(.value.passed))' && make eval ARGS='--suite replies' && tail -n 1 evals/results.jsonl | jq -e '.suite == "replies" and .jev == false and (.scores | to_entries | all(.value.passed))'

description: After a run, a routine request in the mailbox carries the rendered question block unchanged inside a rewritten opening and closing. Expect: all pass.
command: uv run pytest -m integration tests/integration/test_polish_message.py -k question_block_unchanged

description: A rewrite that fails either check sends the rendered request as it is. Expect: all pass.
command: uv run pytest -m integration tests/integration/test_polish_message.py -k rejected_rewrite

description: A fresh clone runs with `cp .env.example .env` and one command, with no keys: the three services come up healthy and a waited run start settles. Expect: exit 0.

Replay reproduces the demo run with no network call to a model: a run start, the fixture replies and lead 008's packet approval against the running app in replay, while the app's outbound HTTP shows no request to a model or Jev host. Expect: all pass.
The reviewer and the cross-review report no blocker, and the README holds the run command, the architecture overview, the eval loop, the skills table and "Cut and why". Expect: `5`.
command: grep -c -E '^## (Run it|Architecture|The eval loop|Skills|Cut and why)' README.md
